discoverer: M. van Hoeij (quintic curve); F. Najman (degree-10 lift)
reference: F. Najman, degree-10 torsion computations (2026), unpublished.
notes: The quadratic full-2-torsion extension of the quintic C30 curve 30a. The submitted points have exact orders 2 and 30 and are independent; good unramified degree-one reduction bounds the full torsion by 60. Sporadicity in absolute degree 10 is UNDECIDED; do not label this point sporadic on the basis of the quintic result. Current gonality bounds are 10 <= gonality <= 12. One representative per isomorphism class of (K,E), following the verifier deduplication convention. Underlying quintic curves: van Hoeij; see F. Najman, Classification of torsion of elliptic curves over quintic fields, https://github.com/F-Najman/quintic-torsion.
